content: Implement controllers for POST/DELETE /api/users/:id/sports with authorization and error handling
activeForm: Implementing controllers for POST/DELETE /api/users/:id/sports with authorization and error handling
description: Implement user-sports.controller.ts with addUserSport and removeUserSport methods that handle POST and DELETE /api/users/:id/sports endpoints. Implements authorization checks (users can only manage their own sports, 403 for others), payload validation using schemas from T4.1, and proper error handling for duplicate sports (409) and not found (404). Uses repository layer from T4.1. Write 8 MVP-tier tests (4 unit tests for authorization and validation logic, 4 integration tests for controller-repository interaction). This subtask will be integrated with routes in T4.3.

checkpoints.name: Authorization Logic Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Controller methods addUserSport and removeUserSport created with authorization checks (req.user.id === req.params.id)

checkpoints.name: Controller Implementation and Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: Both controller methods complete with all 8 tests passing (authorization, validation, error handling verified)

phases.name: addUserSport Controller Implementation
actions: Create: src/services/user-service/controllers/user-sports.controller.ts
Implement: addUserSport(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response)
Check: Authorization - verify req.user.id === parseInt(req.params.id) (403 if mismatch)
Validate: Payload using addSportSchema from T4.1
Check: User exists (404 if not found or soft-deleted)
Use: UserSportsRepository.addUserSport(userId, sportData) from T4.1
Return: 201 with created UserSport object
Handle: Duplicate sport returns 409 Conflict
Handle: Invalid sport_name or skill_level returns 400
Handle: User not found returns 404
phases.gate: addUserSport must enforce authorization and handle all error cases before proceeding

phases.name: removeUserSport Controller Implementation
actions: Implement: removeUserSport(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response)
Check: Authorization - verify req.user.id === parseInt(req.params.id) (403 if mismatch)
Extract: sportName from req.params.sport (URL-decode if needed)
Check: User exists (404 if not found)
Use: UserSportsRepository.removeUserSport(userId, sportName) from T4.1
Return: 204 No Content on successful deletion
Handle: Sport not found returns 404 (idempotent - could also return 204)
Handle: User not found returns 404

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (8 tests)
actions: Write: 4 unit tests for authorization and validation logic
Test: addUserSport - user can add sport to own profile (201)
Test: addUserSport - user cannot add sport to other profile (403)
Test: removeUserSport - user can remove own sport (204)
Test: removeUserSport - user cannot remove other's sport (403)
Write: 4 integration tests for controller-repository interaction
Test: addUserSport - duplicate sport returns 409
Test: addUserSport - invalid skill_level returns 400
Test: removeUserSport - non-existent sport returns 404 (or 204)
Test: Both methods - non-existent user returns 404
Verify: All 8 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of controller layer
